title: Contact

title: Your Privacy Choices
body:
As described in our Privacy Policy, we collect personal information from your interactions with us and our website, including through cookies and similar technologies. We may also share this personal information with third parties, including advertising partners. We do this in order to show you ads on other websites that are more relevant to your interests and for other reasons outlined in our privacy policy.

Sharing of personal information for targeted advertising based on your interaction on different websites may be considered "sales", "sharing", or "targeted advertising" under certain U.S. state privacy laws. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to opt out of these activities. If you would like to exercise this opt-out right, please follow the instructions below.

If you visit our website with the Global Privacy Control opt-out preference signal enabled, depending on where you are, we will treat this as a request to opt-out of activity that may be considered a “sale” or “sharing” of personal information or other uses that may be considered targeted advertising for the device and browser you used to visit our website.

title: About Us
body:
The hydration brand for people who actually read the label.

FORTIFIED® was built on a simple promise — No Mumbo Jumbo. No proprietary blends. No fillers you can't pronounce. No fear-mongering marketing. Just real ingredients in honest amounts, every milligram printed on the label.

Why we exist

Most “hydration” drinks are flavored sugar water pretending to be healthy. We built FORTIFIED® differently — because the label should tell the truth, and the dose should actually do something.

Every blend starts with a transparent electrolyte base: 1,210mg sodium from Ancient Ocean® Pink Himalayan Salt, 1,000mg magnesium malate, 220mg potassium from real coconut water, and 1,940mg chloride. From there we stack in function — Vitamin D3 + K2 for daily structure/function support, natural caffeine from real coffee bean for clean energy, and single-ingredient creatine for performance.* No proprietary blends. No filler. Just real ingredients that pull their weight.

The label promise

  • Every milligram disclosed. No proprietary blends, ever.
  • Zero sugar, zero artificial sweeteners. Sweetened with monk fruit and fermented Reb M — never sucralose or aspartame.
  • Real minerals. Sodium from Pink Himalayan Salt. Potassium from real coconut water. Magnesium as malate, not oxide.
  • Natural caffeine. From real coffee bean — never caffeine anhydrous, never synthetic stimulants.
  • Single-ingredient supplements. Our Creatine is one ingredient. That's the whole label.

How it's made

FORTIFIED® products are manufactured in the USA in a cGMP-compliant facility, with raw ingredients third-party tested before they go into a stick pack. Our flavor systems use Organic Lemon Juice Powder and natural flavor extracts — Salty Orange and Salty Watermelon — so what's on the front of the pouch matches what's on the back.

Our mission

To help you hydrate with purpose.

FORTIFIED® exists to upgrade the way people fuel their bodies — starting with water. Every product is designed to do more than just quench thirst. It's built to support energy, focus, performance, and recovery with clean, functional ingredients that work as hard as you do.*

Built for label-readers, by label-readers.

If you've ever flipped a pouch over, googled the seventh ingredient, and put it back on the shelf — this brand was built for you. Shop the lineup or read about why we built it this way.

* These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. These products are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

Zero sugar. Zero artificial sweeteners.

We sweeten with monk fruit and fermented Reb M (OnoSweet®). No sucralose. No aspartame. No “maltodextrin for flavor.” 0g added sugar in every stick pack.

Real caffeine, not a chemical version of it.

Energy delivers 152mg of caffeine from real coffee bean — never caffeine anhydrous, never synthetic stimulants. A clean lift you can feel, with no afternoon crash.

Our Creatine is creatine monohydrate. That's the whole label. No fillers, no proprietary blends, no anti-caking junk. The form that's been studied for decades, dosed honestly.

title: Are you FORTIFIED®?
body:
The hydration you drink should be as honest as the day you're trying to win.

FORTIFIED® is the label-reader's hydration brand. If you've ever flipped a pouch over and put it back — you already know why we built it this way.

What does it mean to be FORTIFIED®?

  • You read labels before you read marketing.
  • You want sodium, magnesium, and potassium at actually useful amounts — not a sprinkle on top of a sugar mix.
  • You don't want caffeine anhydrous or sucralose hiding in your morning drink.
  • You want a brand that prints every milligram on the front and the back.

Take the label test

Pick up whatever you're drinking right now. Find the supplement facts panel. Ask yourself:

  1. Does it list every milligram, or hide doses behind a “proprietary blend”?
  2. How much sodium is in one serving? (You lose 700–1,500mg in an hour of sweat.)
  3. Is it sweetened with monk fruit or with sucralose / aspartame?
  4. If it has caffeine — is it from real coffee bean, or caffeine anhydrous?

If you can't answer those questions from the label alone, the label isn't telling you everything. FORTIFIED® fixes that: 1,210mg sodium from Pink Himalayan Salt, 1,000mg magnesium malate, 220mg potassium, 0g added sugar, every gram disclosed.

Ready to make the switch?
